_about: Requirements register. Values and pass/fail are NOT typed here: scripts/requirements_matrix.py pulls them from the generated outputs, so the matrix cannot drift from the analysis. Value sources: kin = kinematics_summary.csv metric (its own status), veh = vehicle_derived.json key, chk_min = minimum of a member_checks.csv column, joint_min = minimum of a joint_checks.csv column, mis_min = minimum misalignment margin, upl = upright_loads.json key, brg = bearings.json key (dotted path), bolt_min = minimum of a bolt_checks.csv column, fea = upright_fea.json key and fat = upright_fatigue.json key (STALE if their inputs changed since they ran), intf_count = interference.csv status count, mass_part = summed mass_budget.csv rows of one part, mass_unsprung = mass budget, open = not yet verified (later week).
